articles.eng: 폭염에 유럽 가스 가격, 이란 전쟁 고점 수준 육박
articles.body: Widespread heatwaves across Europe are pushing natural gas prices close to levels last seen during the peak of the Iran war crisis, as demand for gas-fired power generation surges.

articles.headline: Panama Canal Fees Hit Record High as El Niño and Iran War Choke Shipping
articles.eng: 파나마 운하 통행료 사상 최고 — 엘니뇨·이란 전쟁으로 해운 위축
articles.body: Falling water levels caused by El Niño combined with Iran war disruptions could limit transit slots through the crucial maritime passageway, sending fees to record highs.

articles.headline: Yen Sinks as Effect of US-Japan Intervention Fades
articles.eng: 美日 외환개입 효과 소멸에 엔화 재차 하락
articles.body: The Japanese yen is sinking again as the effects of the coordinated US-Japan currency intervention earlier this month begin to fade, raising concerns about renewed currency volatility.
